author: Kevin Kelly
short: Native Discord music with direct/slash controls, automatic channel selection, and idle disconnect.
description: Music search and playback inside Red using yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and native Discord voice with DAVE support. Includes direct play/skip/queue commands and matching slash controls. Joins your voice channel, or the available voice channel with the most people if you are not in voice. Disconnects after the queue is idle for 10 seconds. No Lavalink server is needed. Install PyNaCl>=1.5.0,<1.6 and davey>=0.1.6 once in Red's Python environment, plus FFmpeg, libopus, and Deno 2.3+ or Node.js 22+ in the Red container. Working voice libraries from Downloader remain supported. Unload Red's bundled Audio cog before loading AudioPlus.
install_msg: Read https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/audioplus/README.md before loading. Downloader installs yt-dlp and EJS. Native voice also requires PyNaCl>=1.5.0,<1.6 and davey>=0.1.6, installed once in Red's Python environment; cog updates keep existing voice libraries. Install FFmpeg, libopus, and a supported JavaScript runtime inside the Red container. Restart Red after changing voice libraries. Unload Red's bundled Audio cog first if loaded. Use [p]audiostatus to check local dependencies, then [p]play <query>. Play joins your voice channel, or the available channel with the most people, and leaves after the queue is idle for 10 seconds. For slash commands, the owner runs [p]slash enablecog audioplus and [p]slash sync after loading. Legacy [p]audio commands remain available. No Lavalink node is required.
end_user_data_statement: Preserves global legacy Lavalink settings, including the node password, in Red Config for rollback. Native playback does not use them. Queues, track metadata, request contexts, volume, repeat mode, and playback failures are held in memory only. yt-dlp disk caching and downloads are disabled. No listening histories or playlists are persisted by the cog.
